body.name: Fully covered unlabeled perfect-surgery class \(\mathcal M_p\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_p=\{(G,B,\omega,\tau,\{\Sigma_c,\pi_c\}_{c\in C}):\Sigma_0=A^{-1}\Omega A^{-\top},\ \Sigma_j=(A^{(j)})^{-1}\Omega^{(j)}(A^{(j)})^{-\top}\ \forall j\in V,\ [\operatorname{Pa}(j)\neq\varnothing\ \text{or}\ \tau_j\neq\omega_j]\ \forall j\in V,\ \pi_c>0\ \forall c\in C,\ \sum_{c\in C}\pi_c=1\}\).
